name: Caprese Salad

ingredients.name: best-quality ripe tomatoes, mixed sizes, at room temperature
best-quality fresh mozzarella cheese, torn into bite-size chunks
Coarse sea salt, such as Maldon or fleur de sel

instructions.primary_message: Cut tomatoes into an assortment of slices and chunks and spread over a large plate in a single, slightly overlapping layer. Tuck chunks of mozzarella among the tomato pieces. Drizzle generously with extra-virgin olive oil. Sprinkle with coarse sea salt and black pepper. Tear basil leaves into small pieces with your fingertips and spread them on top. Serve immediately.

schema_metadata.keywords: basil, caprese, easy, Italian, mozzarella, olive oil, quick, salad, tomato

description: The best tomatoes, basil, and mozzarella you can find sprinkled with salt and pepper, drizzled with good olive oil. This version is best without balsamic vinegar.
notes: Notes: If you have fresh mozzarella from the dairy, do not refrigerate it, as this will cause it to tighten and lose its juicy texture. If you find yourself with refrigerated mozzarella, the best way to restore it to its former glory is by submerging it in warm, salty milk for a spell.
author: J. Kenji López-Alt
